scientific.integrity: The claim is proved directly from nested neighborhoods and independently checked by exact exhaustive enumeration. The complete-bipartite identity is presented as a consistency specialization, not as the originality-bearing contribution.
limitations: A poorly indexed or inaccessible source could contain the same chain-graph factorization; no such source was located in the searches performed.
The 2020 chain-graph paper inspected studies secure total domination, not enumeration of all total dominating sets.
Finite exhaustive verification through total order eleven is corroboration only; the arbitrary-order theorem rests on the symbolic proof.

title: Total and connected total domination polynomials of chain graphs
